projects.name: Claude Wait Board
projects.one: An iPad status board that shows every running Claude task at a glance
projects.desc: Like a pickup board at a fast-food counter, each task gets a number and moves between Working, Needs attention and Done. Tasks waiting on a permission prompt flash the whole screen red, finished ones flash green, with a chime for each. A small server on the Mac collects live signals from Claude app chats and Claude Code.
projects.stack: Python, HTML/JavaScript, Claude extension mods, Claude Code hooks
